title: equisetum × nelsonii
intro: Equisetum × nelsonii, commonly known as Nelson's horsetail, is a hybrid plant that belongs to the Equisetaceae family. This plant is known for its therapeutic properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Equisetum × nelsonii include its ability to improve respiratory function, lower blood pressure, and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include silica, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
